The Deterministic Null [E · reported_j]

Against a SHA-256 pre-committed zero-model lookup arm (Shape D, bit-exact in Rust/C++20/Go/Julia/Python), 6 LLMs tied or trailed on 9/10 bounded template cells (N=2,840) — yet led +45.8 to +95.0 pp on open suites.

1/2 Cold generalization vs bounded templates:
- Track-A (N=2,840, K_eff=6-12 saturation): 9/10 single-turn ties vs zero-model Shape D
- Open Track-B (BFCL v3, tau-bench, BigCodeBench, N=1,190): LLMs led +45.83 to +95.00 pp
- SWE-bench repos: Opus 5.5 5/6 vs Shape D 0/6

2/2 Scope & limits:
- t=2 replay (5/6 at 0 calls) is exact hash-addressed recall, NOT unseen generalization; AST/spec edits invalidate cache
- Zipf(0.85) cut local M5 Max L3 reported_j 3.59x (1.77 uJ mmap probe; measured_j=null, cloud API watts unmetered)
